The final frozen candidate emits 2159 bytes versus 2115: precisely 44 bytes of SPIFF APP8 signalling, in 34-byte and 10-byte segments at offsets 2 and 36. Direct removal yields the byte-identical full predecessor stream, and 2078 entropy bytes are identical. Both original-Consumer cross-decodes verify 37,761,024 samples with zero error. Preserve explicit RGB interpretation; no entropy compression regression, latency waiver, independent-oracle claim or timing claim is inferred.

The direct fourth-versus-third short 16 p16-noise decode ratio 1.13532270 (+4.062500 microseconds) remains an investigation finding. Its paired-ratio percentile 95% interval 0.95498–1.38925 and conservative interval 0.90201–1.43504 include 1, but absence of confirmation does not prove equivalence. Preparation improves across all six cases and the selected candidate keeps source-proven redundant admission/container removal; those benefits do not waive this decode finding. This is incremental diagnostic evidence, not a second pinned baseline or a production-policy exception.
